stories.title: Don’t fear a referendum, PQ leader says in final debate of election campaign

en.title: Quebec doctors call for inquest after five physician suicides in 5 months
en.summary: Quebec medical professionals are requesting an inquest following five physician deaths by suicide within a five-month period. Doctors report facing daily exposure to death and suffering with significant responsibility but insufficient support systems.

en.title: Quebec doctors call for inquest into suicides among profession
en.summary: Five doctors in Quebec reportedly died by suicide within a five-month period in the current year, prompting calls for an official inquest into the deaths.
